method: All 150 identified against Stage25 and 243-ID triage roster; page-level verified findings are explicitly marked. An unreviewed supplied link or GCatholic directory is NOT a source verification; physical site, exact point, title, current rite, and canonical eligibility are separate gates. Second pass expanded page-scope checks using institutional, civil, sanctuary-custodian and Catholic shrine-association pages. These are independently reviewed sources, not approved sites. Third pass inspected official church, public tourism, episcopal conference and Catholic shrine-association sources; future announcements do not establish completed construction. Final pass individually adjudicated the last 36 named source records. Five were placed in non-admission holds despite source review: CD-Lubumbashi, FR-Blanot separate chapel, PR-Cupey unbuilt sanctuary structure, TL-Dili Fatima ambiguous designation, UG-Lodonga primary basilica evidence. All owner/coordinate/publication decisions remain pending.
notes: Page-level research outcomes rely on the linked institutional, governmental or secondary source as stated, not automated checks of all 150 supplied pages. Source screening never reserves a Place ID or approves publication.

records.name: National Shrine of Our Lady of Aitara, Soibada

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Timor-Leste Tatoli reports national pilgrimage from Soibada Parish Church to hilltop Chapel of Our Lady of Aitara; distinct physical sites. National pilgrimage description is not itself formal canonical National Shrine decree.

records.name: Shrine of Our Lady of Fátima, Dili

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Dili Archdiocese explicitly lists Fatubessi shrine in Ermera and Ramelau mountain Fatima pilgrimage centre, neither an independently identified standalone shrine in Dili city. The proposed Dili Our Lady of Fatima may conflate multiple sites. Hold.

records.name: St Polycarp Catholic Church, İzmir

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Izmir Catholic Church says St Polycarp Church currently closed for worship/visits due renovation; status is time-sensitive

records.name: House of the Virgin Mary, Ephesus

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Turkish national tourism portal identifies pilgrimage to Mary's shrine at Ephesus / Selçuk; coordinate must target the House of Virgin Mary and not the broader Ephesus archaeology route.

records.name: Metropolitan Basilica-Cathedral of the Assumption, Lviv

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Cathedral official page confirms the Latin metropolitan basilica in Lviv

records.name: Basilica of the Blessed Virgin Mary — Lodonga, Uganda

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: GCatholic documents claimed 1961 Basilica of Blessed Virgin Mary at Lodonga, Yumbe but no independently retrievable diocesan statement of title/physical building from this pass. Research lead only; hold title/point.

records.name: Basilica of Saint Mary, Minneapolis

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Minneapolis government heritage listing explicitly identifies Basilica of Saint Mary; landmark record is not proof of 1962 liturgical programme.

records.name: Our Lady of Clear Creek Abbey

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Abbey itself confirms active Solesmes Benedictine community and Oklahoma monastery; do not imply externally fixed liturgical schedule

records.name: Mission San Juan Capistrano

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Diocese of Orange identifies active Mission Basilica parish at 31520 Camino Capistrano and references historic Mission San Juan Capistrano as national shrine; separate building and site-footprint decision required.

records.name: National Shrine of Saint Dymphna, Massillon

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: National Shrine of St Dymphna states it is INSIDE St Mary's Church, Massillon; physical single-building site; access through gift shop when church locked.

records.name: National Shrine of Saint Jude, Chicago

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: NASPA lists Claretian National Shrine of St Jude, Chicago, separately from Dominican Shrine of St Jude Thaddeus, Chicago; must not collapse or transfer national title to Dominican site.

records.name: National Shrine of Saint Thérèse, Darien

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Carmelite custodian lists National Shrine of St Thérèse at 8433 Bailey Rd and museum at 8501 Bailey Rd, both Darien campus; shrine and museum not identical entrance.

records.name: Our Lady of Guadalupe Seminary — Denton

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: FSSP Our Lady of Guadalupe Seminary confirms institution and Denton campus physical address 7880 W Denton Road; educational/formation institution, do not imply public access or ordinary parish Mass.

records.name: Our Lady of the Angels Monastery, Hanceville

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Cullman Chamber of Commerce lists Shrine of Most Blessed Sacrament of Our Lady of Angels Monastery at 3224 County Road 548, Hanceville; cloistered Poor Clares and public shrine form a campus, not two unrelated churches.

records.name: Saint Kateri Tekakwitha Shrine, Fonda

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Saint Kateri Shrine Fonda current visitor site distinguishes winter grounds from closed St Peter chapel, museum and no Mass November–April; keep season/visit claims source-scoped.

records.name: Shrine of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal, Perryville

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Association of Miraculous Medal identifies National Shrine, Perryville at 1805 W St Joseph St (association postal office 1811), not exact entrance GPS.

records.name: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Verdún, Minas

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Uruguay Episcopal Conference confirms National Shrine of Virgen del Verdún in Minas; national designation covers hilltop statue, Way of Cross, chapel and retreat house, so map feature needs selection.

records.name: Basilica of Our Lady of Coromoto, Guanare

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Venezuelan Episcopal Conference confirms National Sanctuary and Minor Basilica of Our Lady of Coromoto built at apparition site; distinct from Guanare cathedral formerly holding relic.

records.name: Sanctuary of the Holy Christ of La Grita

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Venezuelan bishops' conference 2024 distinguishes Basílica del Espíritu Santo, from which Holy Christ image is moved, and separately located Santuario Diocesano. Source candidate must not pin image's destination to the basilica automatically.

records.name: Shrine of Our Lady of the Valley, Margarita

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Current sanctuary custodian describes Santuario Diocesano Basílica Menor Nuestra Señora del Valle at final Avenida Concepción Mariño, El Valle del Espíritu Santo, Margarita, Venezuela.

records.name: Basilica of Our Lady of Sở Kiện

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Vietnamese bishops' conference documents Immaculate Conception Church at Sở Kiện declared minor basilica December 8, 2011; separate Martyrs Pilgrimage Centre/museum buildings share property, not one identical structure.

records.name: Our Lady of Măng Đen Shrine

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Kon Tum diocese identifies Our Lady of Măng Đen pilgrimage centre in Măng Đen commune; statue/shrine physical feature still requires map choice.

records.name: Our Lady of Trà Kiệu Shrine

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Đà Nẵng diocesan history explicitly distinguishes Trà Kiệu parish church from Marian hilltop sanctuary chapel built on Bửu Châu; do not pin both to one generic locality.

records.name: Our Lady of Tà Pao Shrine

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Phan Thiết diocese describes Tà Pao hilltop Marian statue, altar and wider pilgrimage structures; single local diocesan devotion centre not automatic separate basilica.

records.name: Shrine of Father Trương Bửu Diệp, Tắc Sậy

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: Vietnam Tourism describes Tắc Sậy Church in Phong Thạnh as a pilgrimage site and burial place of Fr Trương Bửu Diệp; shrine/tomb belong to the church complex.

records.name: Shrine of Our Lady of Letnica

web_evidence_review.scope_finding: EU Kosovo July 2026 identifies active pilgrimage to Church of the Assumption of BVM at Letnica where Mother Teresa prayed; Kosovo civil country-area prerequisite remains missing.
